## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Fix the parser so `--wait` still works before this merges: the decision added in `docs/adr/007-timeout.md` keeps it as a deprecated alias, but the code removes it, so existing invocations now fail.

## Changes
The pull request renames the CLI option `--wait` to `--timeout` in `parse_args`, updates the CLI tests to use the new name, adds an ADR on the terminology change, and adds a one-line `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Keep `--wait` as a deprecated alias for `--timeout` — `parse_args(["--wait", "12"])` now exits with status 2 ("unrecognized arguments") because only `--timeout` is registered. `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` says to "Accept `--wait` as an alias for one release and emit a deprecation warning when it is used." — Existing scripts that pass `--wait` stop working with no deprecation period, which the ADR says should not happen. — Fix: Add `"--wait"` as a second option string that maps to `dest="timeout"` (or a separate action that sets `timeout` and emits a `DeprecationWarning`), and add a `--wait` case to `test_explicit_options` that checks the warning.
